headline: Jersey barriers and fence at 16 John Road tabled pending more safety review.
summary: MIG Acton, the applicant, asked the board to accept jersey barriers with a chain-link fence on top of a retaining wall, instead of the approved fence and wood guardrails. Board members raised concerns about appearance, safety, and setting a precedent for other applicants. The applicant may send safety information for Graves to review, and the item could return on the 16th or in December. The board also endorsed a land swap between 66 and 70 West Millbury Road.
decisions: Endorsed the plan showing an equal land swap between 66 and 70 West Millbury Road, 6-0.
Tabled the question of whether jersey barriers may stay in place of the approved guardrails at 16 John Road.
discussion: Jersey barriers at 16 John Road: Board members weighed keeping jersey barriers with a fence on top of the retaining wall instead of the approved guardrails. Concerns included appearance, safety, and setting a precedent for other applicants.

Site cleanup at 16 John Road: The applicant's engineer said catch basin hoods are installed, wooden spools are mostly cleared from parking spaces, and wire cutting has stopped. Board members asked for stabilized laydown areas, a cleaner site, and regular maintenance reports to the town.

Subdivision rules update: Staff said the rules were last updated in 2006 and need work on road standards, cited standards, and unclear wording. Staff plans more meetings with departments and the town's consulting engineer and aims for a draft in December.

Ballot question seven: Staff presented estimates from Graves Engineering that 677 parcels could be affected and could yield an additional 1,095 lots. Staff said the figures do not account for wetlands or ledge.

Drone restriction bylaw: Westborough passed an unmanned aircraft systems bylaw, which has gone to the Attorney General's office for review. Board members discussed whether to draft a similar Sutton bylaw and whether to ask residents for input first.
